capabilities: Import print jobs from the Bambu Lab cloud
Plan prints on a queue board from model links
Track filament spools by material and colour
Compute print cost from filament, power, wear and maintenance
Generate a Bases tracker and a print dashboard note
disambiguation: Not a vault sync tool; it imports print jobs from the Bambu Lab cloud and is built to run alongside note-sync services.
extras: Uses an undocumented Bambu Lab cloud API that may change or stop working; the login token is stored in the plugin's data.json inside the vault; LAN-only printers are not synced; remaining filament on a spool is not tracked by the plugin.
motivation: To keep the 3D printing log where the rest of the notes live.
problem: 3D printing logs, spool stock and costs live outside Obsidian, so they are not kept with the rest of the notes.

relations.evidence: paste a MakerWorld, Printables, Thingiverse or Cults3D link
Obsidian Sync, Seafile, iCloud, Syncthing and similar tools copy your notes between devices

summary: Turns Bambu Lab cloud print jobs into notes, plans a print queue from model links, and tracks spools and print cost in Bases tables.
